name: Bill Reminder
description: Captures the provider, amount, billing cycle, and due date from a bill or subscription notice.
instruction: Extract the bill provider, amount due, billing cycle (monthly/quarterly/yearly/one_time), and the due date in ISO-8601. Set autopay only if the message clearly states it.

rules.title: Bill due soon
rules.body: Pay your upcoming bill to avoid late fees.

rules.title: Bill due tomorrow
rules.body: Last day to pay your bill.
